source_text: Caching reduces repeated read latency but introduces invalidation complexity. Cache invalidation should balance freshness and performance.

items.question: Why is cache invalidation difficult?
items.explanation: Invalidation is hard because stale data risk grows when optimizing performance.
items.source_quote: Cache invalidation should balance freshness and performance.

items.question: True or False: Caching always improves correctness.
items.explanation: Caching can hurt correctness when stale values are served without safeguards.
items.source_quote: Caching reduces repeated read latency but introduces invalidation complexity.
